- [EVENT] User has been trying out different marinades and seasoning combinations.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended ingredients and tips for a Korean-style BBQ marinade:
  - Essential Ingredients: Gochujang, soy sauce, garlic, ginger, brown sugar, sesame oil, crushed black pepper.
  - Optional Ingredients: Korean chili flakes, pineapple juice or Korean pear juice, green onions, cumin.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Provided a basic marinade recipe:
  - Ingredients: 1/2 cup soy sauce, 1/4 cup gochujang, 2 cloves garlic (minced and sautéed), 1 inch ginger (grated and sautéed), 2 tablespoons brown sugar, 1 tablespoon sesame oil, 1 teaspoon crushed black pepper, 1/4 teaspoon Korean chili flakes (optional).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Instructions for the marinade: Blend ingredients until smooth, taste and adjust, add optional ingredients if desired.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested marinating time: at least 2 hours or overnight (8-12 hours).
- [EVENT] User has been experimenting with different types of wood chips for BBQ.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended wood chips for Korean-style BBQ:
  1. Korean Oak
  2. Post Oak
  3. Mesquite
  4. Pecan
  5. Cherry
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for using wood chips: soak them, use the right amount, mix and match, monitor temperature.
